R23 clauses not in the task's six required behaviours are not implemented/tested here: 'rich graph hydration', backup/reset/restore owner draining/fencing, and arbitrary per-store PRAGMA preservation beyond a caller-supplied setup(db) hook plus the enforced busy_timeout=5000. No backup/reset/restore API exists in this slice; journal_mode/WAL is deliberately not changed by the service (R24: no global WAL switch).

The 5s 'timeout' is implemented as SQLite's busy_timeout PRAGMA, matching the existing sqlite-memory contract. An Effect.timeout wrapper would be cosmetic because the blocked DatabaseSync call cannot be interrupted.
Open-cleanup close failure (onCleanupFailure operation 'open-cleanup') is reported but not separately asserted; the rollback+close failure path is asserted in item 4.

Sync-facade concurrency: sync methods deliberately bypass the Semaphore (they cannot yield). They are safe only on the single JS thread outside an active Effect transaction; nested sync use inside a transaction is the same owner and is asserted in item 4.
